oracle.independence: Z = T + beta C_A is derived by hand from the two balances and evaluated here in plain arithmetic. Adding beta times the species balance to the energy balance cancels the reaction term identically -- dZ/dt = (Z_f - Z)/tau - gamma (T - T_c) contains no k -- so the bound holds for ANY rate law, Arrhenius or constant, and does not depend on either model's implementation.
